author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Basically, give a x2 credit boost to all players who use 1.8. It'll make the transition smoother for lord knows when we transition into 1.8-1.9. If you use 1.7, you don't receive the boost, but it'd be also nice if you could use maybe 1.8 gadgets if it's compatible to further encourage it.

Probably worth the development time, 1.9 is going to have to be worked out with Mojang still for a bit before it's worth upgrading to anyway.

replies.author: Upsoar
replies.body: It's my understanding that VBOs keeps certain parts of the world from being rendered. So while you're in a cave, the blocks that you can directly see will be rendered, but nothing else. That's why you get can such high FPS while in a cave in 1.8. The only downside to this, is that sometimes it takes a second for the chunks to show up behind you if you were to quickly press F5.
